scene: a shallow bowl of pale green soup on a scratched steel kitchen bench, a swirl of cream not yet stirred in, coarse pepper across it, a wooden spoon resting on the rim of a chipped enamel pan behind, one warm bulb overhead, dark window beyond

a classroom ceiling seen from directly below, loops of gummed paper chain in red and green strung between two strip lights and sagging in the middle, drawing pins in the tile grid, a roll of sugar paper on a high shelf at the edge of frame

a bare tree beside a canal lock at night, strings of small warm lights wound through its branches, black water below holding the reflection in broken lines, wet cobbles and an iron bollard in the foreground, no moon

a large paper backdrop taped flat to a school hall floor, half painted in wide blue brush strokes going from deep to pale, a bucket of water with a brush standing in it, blue footprints along the untouched edge, harsh overhead hall lighting

a hospital car park at eight in the morning in hard frost, white rime on every roof and on the painted bay lines, one small car buried under untouched frost while the bays around it are clear, a low grey sky and a sodium lamp still lit

a chest of drawers with the top drawer pulled fully out and set on the floor, empty except for a loose button and a folded receipt, its contents stacked in neat piles on the carpet beside it, flat afternoon light from one window

two round dark-crusted loaves on a kitchen counter, one whole and one already sliced into a fanned row, flour dust and a bread knife with a worn wooden handle, a folded paper bag and a freezer bag waiting open at the back

a deep bowl of thick orange soup with barley grains visible at the surface, on a bare kitchen table, a torn end of bread beside it on the wood, a paper bag of carrots tipped over behind, single overhead bulb, no other place set

a long dining table after a meal, crumpled paper crowns and cracker debris among used plates, a candle burned two thirds down, eleven mismatched chairs pushed back at angles, a dog lead coiled on the corner of the cloth, warm lamplight
